prompt:
Determine the worst-case asymptotic time complexity of the following code snippet with respect to input n:

```text
for i from 1 to n:
    j = 1
    while j <= i:
        j *= 2
```
explanation: The inner loop runs log₂(i) times for each i. Sum_{i=1}^n log(i) = log(n!) = Θ(n log n) by Stirling's approximation.
